Bring your team together with GUESTPIX!

Company Christmas Party
Photo Sharing

From the 'Ugly Christmas Sweater' to 'Santa's Workshop', bring all your ideas for a company Christmas party together in one private gallery.

 It’s easy to share, fun to relive, and perfect for celebrating company culture!

Create My Gallery
See How It Works
NO APP REQUIRED +

NO GUEST REGISTRATION -
GUESTS JUST SCAN & UPLOAD

A Christmas Gallery by GUESTPIX™ is the perfect last-minute addition so everyone can share their POV using just a QR code or through your private link. 

Your gallery will be filled with festive photos,  and memorable videos that capture the spirit of your holiday party for everyone to enjoy! Best of all, the content is available for your company to repurpose in full-resolution.

2 mins to set up, it's so easy!

How It Works

It's so easy - only takes 2 mins to get started.

CREATE YOUR EVENT
Create your private event gallery in minutes. 

GUESTS SCAN QR CODE / TAP LINK
No guest registration required.

GUESTS UPLOAD
Guests upload photos, videos and messages. All media is labelled with your guests’ name.  

ENJOY
Everything is saved in one live, organized gallery that everyone will enjoy both during & after your event. 

DOWNLOAD IN FULL RESOLUTION
Your gallery can be downloaded in a full-resolution zip.

FUN FEATURES & CUSTOMIZATIONS
Live Slideshow, Private Social Interactions, Digital Invitation & RSVPs, Design Themes, Multi-Lingual & More!

GUESTPIX™ is a digital extension of your event. Let your guests capture the festive spirit, then repurpose that content all year round.

Reasons you'll love it...

1000's OF PHOTOS & VIDEOS

Collect unlimited photos and videos from your delegates or guests giving you a 360 view of your event. Re-purpose content into marketing materials, short videos and across your various digital channels.

PHOTO & VIDEO SLIDESHOW

Project or cast the live slideshow and enjoy as photos and videos are added in real time using the 'live refresh' setting. It's a fabulous way to drive upload engagement from guests.

QR CODE & PRIVATE LINK

Your custom QR code is your ticket to receiving content from your guests. Add it to invitations, table cards, signage, and more! Or send your private link digitally.

ZIP DOWNLOAD

Ready to download your event gallery? Everything from guests is neatly organized, in a full-resolution zipped file and ready to download within 12 months of your event.

WHITE LABELLING

Our white label solution allows brands to fully align the platform with their business identity, offering a seamless and cohesive experience for your audience. Ensuring every touchpoint feels authentically yours, enhancing brand recognition and trust.

CUSTOMER SUPPORT

Our friendly customer support team is available 7 days a week for any inquiries you may have. Reach out via our live chat or email us at customercare@guestpix.com

Christmas Party Slideshow

Enjoy watching all the photos and videos from your gallery displayed on the big screen! Simply activate the slideshow feature so everyone can enjoy the best moments as they play in the background of your event.

Pricing

Hosting a business or charity event?

Explore these packages designed specifically for your event.

GUESTPIX Reviews

"We've absolutely loved using GUESTPIX! After doing quite a bit of research and comparing different platforms, GUESTPIX stood out right away with top-notch customer service and an easy-to-use system that just works. It's been a game-changer for us when it comes to sharing photos across the company, quick, simple, and actually fun to use. One of our favorite uses so far? We incorporated it into our company-wide Christmas scavenger hunt, and it was a hit! GUESTPIX made it easy for everyone to join in, share moments, and feel connected, whether they were in the field or the office. We're excited to be long-term customers and can't wait to find even more creative ways to put it to work."
Shannon

"I researched a lot of online photo galleries to find the right one for our event series and GUESTPIX was a clear winner in my eyes. We required a platform where our supporters could share their photos, videos and messages from our flagship event series. With six events in total, GUESTPIX Business was the perfect option so we could have an album for each event. It was quick and easy to get set up, and the friendly customer service team were on hand to support if needed. We were delighted to be able to add our branding to the gallery with our logo, welcome message, images and web URLs, making it feel authentic. Plus, there are so many great features to choose from. We were very impressed with GUESTPIX and most importantly, our supporters loved it and said how easy it was to use. All in all a great way to showcase memories made our event."

Lizzie | Alzheimer's Research UK

"GUESTPIX was perfect for our event. Our convention attendees had fun adding their photos, and we were able to create multiple albums to use for different parts of the event - and then provide separate QR codes for each one. The helpful GUESTPIX staff were terrific, and every question or concern was quickly addressed. From start to finish it was a great experience!"

Vince | Australia

"As a global event, media, and activation agency - we believe strongly in human connection and the importance of meaningful and personal connections. We use GUESTPIX as a super easy way for our teams traveling the world and activating events for our clients to share in the behind-the-scenes and the fun moments of their daily tasks and jobs. Allows the entire agency to see the real world of executing and the personality and fun behind our people doing it. GUESTPIX gathers all the images by date so you can go through a journey of what we really do as an agency. It's super easy to upload from your computer or phone and keeps our staff connected in pictures to each other."

Jennifer | We Are Haute USA

“Carla & Warwick have been amazing in helping us with a photo collation service for a virtual event we run on behalf of our client. We were struggling to find an easy-to-understand and intuitive platform for our guests to upload their photos – GUESTPIX was the perfect solution. Carla and Warwick helped us through all the stages of the event and even helped us tweak the page to fall in line with the event branding all for an exceptional cost. We will certainly be using GUESTPIX again in future for our events and highly recommend anyone looking for a straightforward, accessible and malleable photo collation. Thank you!”

Sam | Event Production Agency | UK

More About GUESTPIX™ Christmas Parties

The holiday season is all about celebrating, and choosing the right Christmas themes can make any gathering feel extra special. Whether you’re planning a cozy family get-together or a large company event, there are countless Christmas holiday themes to suit every occasion. From classic winter wonderlands to fun, modern takes like “Ugly Sweater” or “Santa’s Workshop,” the right theme sets the mood for a memorable time.

With every GUESTPIX™ purchase, you will receive access to 50+ editable Canva templates. And no corporate holiday party idea is complete without the perfect Christmas party invitations to get everyone excited. Whether hosting a small family dinner or a grand corporate event, a well-designed invite adds a personal touch. Many businesses now use a Christmas QR code on their invitations, making it easy for guests to upload and share photos from the celebration. It’s a simple yet effective way to keep everything organized and connected. Games are a must for any holiday celebration! Whether you’re looking for holiday games to play with friends and family or planning office Christmas party games to bring some fun to the workplace, interactive activities help keep the festive spirit alive. From trivia and gift exchanges to team challenges and scavenger hunts, the right games can turn any holiday gathering into an unforgettable experience. For businesses and teams, finding unique company Christmas party ideas is key to throwing a celebration that employees will actually enjoy. Whether it’s a themed dinner, a virtual holiday party, or a charity-driven event, creating a fun and engaging atmosphere fosters team bonding and holiday cheer. If you’re planning a work Xmas do, incorporating photo-sharing platforms like GUESTPIX™ or QR code-based activities can enhance the experience and make it easy to capture and share memories. Family gatherings during the holidays wouldn’t be the same without festive photos. If you’re looking for family Christmas photo ideas, consider themed outfits, outdoor winter settings, or cozy at-home snapshots in front of the Christmas tree. Whether formal or fun, holiday photos captured with GUESTPIX™ are a great way to preserve memories and share the joy of the season. No matter how you celebrate, thoughtful planning and creative ideas help make every holiday gathering special. From invitations and games to memorable photos, bringing people together is what the season is all about!
